purpose: Ceiling rejection screen: executable component repair coupled to irreversible partial-refund recovery; one constructed scenario, not independent upstream application execution.
stopping_rule: Exactly one complete Sol max attempt, 100 actions, 600 seconds/request and 3600 seconds/episode. Freeze source and plan before collection. Retain every outcome; no silent retry or selective replacement.
decision: A clean delivery rejects this candidate as evidence of high difficulty. A task failure requires fresh replay and causal audit; infrastructure/format/runtime failures do not establish cognitive difficulty. One cognitive failure is only a candidate signal, not broad high-difficulty proof. If solved, stop extending these miniature SQL fixtures as the frontier mainline; retain as regression only.
